duga-tagline: The project tagline, shown under the name on the home page. Keep it short. In your language, feel free to choose a natural local term rather than transliterating "queer" if there's a better-established one -- see the /about page for the terminology policy.
duga-nav-home: Link label in the site navigation, goes back to the home page.
duga-nav-about: Link label in the site navigation, goes to the About page.
duga-nav-login: Link label in the site navigation to log in with a Wikimedia account, shown only to logged-out visitors.
duga-nav-logout: Button label in the site navigation to log out, shown only to logged-in visitors.
duga-home-title: The project name, shown as the main heading on the home page. This is a proper noun ("Duga") -- most languages should leave it untranslated, like a brand name.
duga-home-intro: One-paragraph explanation of what Duga is, shown on the home page below the title.
duga-home-pick-language: Label above the list of languages a visitor can choose to browse.
duga-home-interface-language: Label for the interface-language switcher: a dropdown of languages used to translate the site's own UI, independent of which language's content a visitor is browsing.
duga-home-interface-language-submit: Button label to submit the interface-language switcher form.
duga-lang-home-title: Page heading for a single language's overview. $1 is the autonym of that language (e.g. "Français").
duga-lang-home-placeholder: Placeholder shown on a language overview page before gap detection exists yet (milestone M0/M1). Will be replaced with real content in a later milestone.
duga-lang-home-back: Link back to the home page's language list.
duga-lang-home-stale: Warning shown when a detector's last run failed, so visitors know the gap list below may not reflect the current state of Wikimedia projects. $1 is a timestamp of the last successful run.
duga-lang-home-gap-count: Summary line showing how many gaps were found for this language. $1 is the count (a number).
duga-lang-home-view-gaps: Link label to the full gap list for this language.
duga-lang-home-no-gaps: Shown when detectors have run for this language but found zero gaps.
duga-lang-home-view-vocabulary: Link label to this language's vocabulary list.
duga-gaps-title: Page heading for the gap list. $1 is the autonym of the language being browsed (e.g. "Français").
duga-gaps-back: Link back from the gap list to that language's overview page.
duga-gaps-empty: Shown when a gap list (possibly filtered) has no matching rows.
duga-gaps-what: Combines a project name and a gap-type description into one phrase for a gap row, e.g. "Wikipedia — no article yet". $1 is the project name (see duga-gaps-project-*), $2 is the gap-type description (see duga-gaps-type-*).
duga-gaps-project-wikipedia: The Wikipedia project name, shown in a gap row. Usually a proper noun, left untranslated.
duga-gaps-project-wikidata: The Wikidata project name, shown in a gap row. Usually a proper noun, left untranslated.
duga-gaps-type-no_article: Short description of the 'no_article' gap type: no Wikipedia article exists yet in this language.
duga-gaps-type-no_label: Short description of the 'no_label' gap type: the Wikidata item has no label yet in this language.
duga-gaps-type-no_description: Short description of the 'no_description' gap type: the Wikidata item has no description yet in this language.
duga-gaps-maturity-stable: Label for a detector whose results are considered reliable/stable.
duga-gaps-maturity-beta: Label for a detector whose results are still being validated.
duga-gaps-maturity-experimental: Label for a detector whose results are experimental and may be wrong or incomplete.
duga-gaps-why-in-scope: Explains which scope rule(s) made this topic count as in-scope, shown on each gap row. $1 is a comma-separated list of rule labels.
duga-gaps-fix-button: Button/link label on a gap row that takes the visitor to where they can actually fix the gap (e.g. the Wikidata item's sitelinks section).
duga-gaps-prev-page: Pagination link label to the previous page of gaps.
duga-gaps-next-page: Pagination link label to the next page of gaps.
duga-account-title: Page heading for the logged-in visitor's own account page.
duga-account-username: States which Wikimedia account is currently logged in. $1 is the username.
duga-account-attribution-title: Section heading for the public-attribution opt-out control on the account page. This is presented prominently at first login, per policy, not buried in a settings menu -- keep it a clear, standalone heading.
duga-account-attribution-explain: Plain-language explanation of what the public-attribution checkbox below it does and doesn't affect, shown at first login and on the account page thereafter. Should stay understandable to someone who has never used Duga before.
duga-account-attribution-checkbox: Label for the checkbox controlling whether the visitor's username is shown publicly next to their contributions. Checked by default (opt-out design).
duga-account-attribution-save: Button label to save the attribution preference.
duga-account-continue: Link label to return to whatever page the visitor was on before being sent to complete their first-login attribution choice.
duga-oauth-not-configured-title: Heading shown when a visitor tries to log in but no OAuth consumer has been configured on this installation yet.
duga-oauth-not-configured-body: Body text explaining login isn't available yet, shown on the same page as duga-oauth-not-configured-title.
duga-oauth-error-title: Heading shown when the Wikimedia login round-trip fails or is tampered with (e.g. a mismatched state parameter).
duga-oauth-error-body: Reassures the visitor that nothing was changed on their account, shown alongside duga-oauth-error-title.
duga-oauth-error-retry: Link label to retry the login flow after a failure.
duga-vocab-title: Page heading for the per-language vocabulary list. $1 is the autonym of that language.
duga-vocab-add-title: Heading for the add-a-term form embedded on the vocabulary list page. This is the conference-seeding flow (SPEC.md section 12) -- must stay completable in well under a minute on a phone, so keep this and nearby labels short.
duga-vocab-add-concept-label: Label for the free-text field where a contributor names the concept/notion this word is for (e.g. "genderqueer"). Matched case-insensitively against existing concepts; a new one is created if nothing matches.
duga-vocab-add-word-label: Label for the field where a contributor types the actual word in their language. $1 is the autonym of that language.
duga-vocab-add-note-label: Label for the optional free-text usage-note field on the add-a-term form.
duga-vocab-add-submit: Submit button for the add-a-term form.
duga-vocab-add-login-prompt: Shown instead of the add-a-term form to a logged-out visitor; links to login.
duga-vocab-add-error-required: Error message shown when the add-a-term form was submitted without a concept name or a word.
duga-vocab-add-error-duplicate: Error message shown when the submitted term already exists for that concept/language/word combination.
duga-vocab-add-success: Confirmation message shown after a term is successfully added.
duga-vocab-list-title: Heading above the list of terms on the vocabulary page.
duga-vocab-list-empty: Shown when a vocabulary list (for a language, or for a concept) has no terms yet.
duga-vocab-back: Link back from a term's detail page to that language's vocabulary list.
duga-vocab-register-label: Label for the register dropdown on the add-a-term form (is this word neutral, clinical, a slur, etc).
duga-vocab-register-neutral: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: an everyday, unmarked term.
duga-vocab-register-clinical: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: clinical/medical terminology.
duga-vocab-register-outdated: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: a term once common but now considered dated.
duga-vocab-register-slur: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: a slur. Recorded for documentation purposes (so people know not to use it), never presented as a neutral option.
duga-vocab-register-reclaimed: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: a term reclaimed by the community it was once used against.
duga-vocab-register-regional: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: specific to a region or dialect.
duga-vocab-register-unknown: One of the possible values for a term's register/sensitivity classification: not yet classified. The default for a newly-added term.
duga-vocab-grade-documented: One of the four evidence-grade labels (SPEC.md section 8), shown next to a term's claims: backed by a published source, dictionary, style guide, or law.
duga-vocab-grade-organisational: One of the four evidence-grade labels: a named LGBT+ organisation in that community says so.
duga-vocab-grade-community: One of the four evidence-grade labels: several distinct contributors in Duga have confirmed it (a computed grade, never typed in directly).
duga-vocab-grade-single_report: One of the four evidence-grade labels, and the default for a brand new term: only one person has said so so far.
duga-vocab-lifecycle-local: One of a term/concept's lifecycle states (SPEC.md section 10): exists only in Duga so far.
duga-vocab-lifecycle-proposed: One of a term/concept's lifecycle states: proposed to be promoted to Wikidata (not yet reachable in this milestone).
duga-vocab-lifecycle-upstream: One of a term/concept's lifecycle states: now lives on Wikidata; Duga just holds a pointer (not yet reachable in this milestone).
duga-vocab-concept-link: Link to a term's parent concept page, showing that concept's name. $1 is the concept's label.
duga-vocab-concept-untitled: Shown as a concept's name when it has no local_label set.
duga-vocab-concept-terms-title: Heading above the list of a concept's terms across all its languages, on the concept detail page.
duga-vocab-added-by: States who added a term, when that contributor has opted into public attribution. $1 is their username.
duga-vocab-added-by-anonymous: States that a term's adder chose not to be shown publicly (SPEC.md section 9, attribution opt-out) -- shown instead of duga-vocab-added-by.
duga-vocab-evidence-title: Heading above a term's list of supporting citations on its detail page.
duga-vocab-evidence-empty: Shown when a term has no evidence/citations added yet.
duga-vocab-evidence-link: Link text for a citation's URL, when one was given (not the URL itself, just the link label, e.g. "source").
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-publication: One of the possible evidence-source types: a published work.
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-style_guide: One of the possible evidence-source types: a style guide.
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-dictionary: One of the possible evidence-source types: a dictionary.
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-law: One of the possible evidence-source types: a law or legal text.
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-organisation: One of the possible evidence-source types: a named organisation's statement.
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-other: One of the possible evidence-source types: doesn't fit the other categories.
duga-vocab-evidence-kind-label: Label for the source-type dropdown on the add-evidence form.
duga-vocab-evidence-citation-label: Label for the required citation text field on the add-evidence form.
duga-vocab-evidence-url-label: Label for the optional URL field on the add-evidence form.
duga-vocab-evidence-org-label: Label for the optional organisation-name field on the add-evidence form (relevant when the source type is 'organisation').
duga-vocab-evidence-year-label: Label for the optional year field on the add-evidence form.
duga-vocab-evidence-submit: Submit button for the add-evidence form.
duga-vocab-evidence-add-title: Heading above the add-evidence form on a term's detail page.
duga-vocab-evidence-error-required: Error message shown when the add-evidence form was submitted without a source type or citation.
duga-vocab-evidence-success: Confirmation message shown after evidence is successfully added.
duga-vocab-community-count: States how many contributors have confirmed a term, feeding the 'community' evidence grade. $1 is the count (a number). This i18n system doesn't yet support MediaWiki-style {{PLURAL:}} -- phrasing should stay grammatical for both 0/1 and larger counts as best as possible in your language.
duga-vocab-assert-title: Heading above the agree/disagree form on a term's detail page.
duga-vocab-assert-explain: One-sentence explanation of what the agree/disagree form below it does.
duga-vocab-assert-agree: Radio button label: the contributor agrees with/confirms this term.
duga-vocab-assert-disagree: Radio button label: the contributor disagrees with/disputes this term.
duga-vocab-assert-register-label: Label for the optional dropdown where a contributor can assert what they think the term's register should be.
duga-vocab-assert-register-none: Option in the register-assertion dropdown meaning "I have no opinion on the register".
duga-vocab-assert-note-label: Label for the optional free-text note field on the assert form.
duga-vocab-assert-submit: Submit button for the assert (agree/disagree) form.
duga-vocab-assert-success: Confirmation message shown after an assertion is successfully saved.
duga-about-title: Page heading for the About page.
duga-about-name: Explains the meaning of the project name "Duga" on the About page. Keep "Duga" itself untranslated.
duga-about-body: One-paragraph restatement of the project's purpose, shown on the About page.
duga-about-license: States the software license on the About page.
duga-404-title: Heading shown on the not-found error page.
duga-404-body: Body text on the not-found error page, explaining a link may point to a language that isn't set up yet.
